entry.title: [対応が必要] Node.js: CVE-2026-111497 9.2 CRITICAL ⚠KEV
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：対応が必要 Brotliデコーダーのバッファオーバーフロー。KEV掲載
→ Brotliを1.0.10/1.1.1/1.2.1に更新

A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream. Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries between 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 to the latest available version: 1.0.10 or 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

entry.title: [対応が必要] PHP: CVE-2026-109619 9.2 CRITICAL ⚠KEV
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：対応が必要 PHP本体のグローバル状態が解放済みメモリを参照しRCE。KEV掲載
→ PHPを修正済みのパッチ版に更新

PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Multiple strategies can trigger this condition and produce remote code execution (RCE).

entry.title: [対応が必要] PHP: CVE-2026-109618 9.2 CRITICAL ⚠KEV
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：対応が必要 PHP本体のOOM処理の不備でRCE。KEV掲載
→ PHPを修正済みのパッチ版に更新

PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code execution (RCE).

entry.title: [対応が必要] WordPress: CVE-2026-87902 8.1 HIGH ⚠KEV
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：対応が必要 WordPress本体で認証なしにローカルPHPを読込、条件次第でRCE。KEV掲載
→ WordPressを修正済みの版に更新

An unauthenticated attacker can make `get_page_template()` page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories. If relevant pre-conditions for both the server and the active theme are met, this can lead to RCE.
